basics.name: Haesol Shin
basics.label: Undergraduate Researcher
basics.summary: Undergraduate student majoring in Artificial Intelligence at Chungnam National University. Undergraduate research assistant at DOLAB (Prof. Sangmook Kim), interested in Text-to-Speech, speech synthesis, controllable speech generation, and generative AI. Also actively exploring AI agents and agentic workflows, including contributing to open-source AI coding agent projects.

work.name: DOLAB (Data Optimization Lab), Chungnam National University
highlights: First-authored "Analyzing and Improving Voice Consistency in Voice Design TTS," accepted to the Korea Computer Congress (KCC) 2026 as a Regular Track oral presentation.
Studied speaker identity drift in natural-language-guided TTS; designed a training pipeline with special conditioning tokens and teacher-forcing-based consistency loss.
Built a reproducible benchmark dataset; evaluated voice consistency via generation-to-generation cosine similarity of speaker embeddings.

work.name: Thisisthepy Group
highlights: Built the REPL UI and rendering layer for PyREPL, a cross-platform Python REPL for Android, iOS, and Desktop.
Integrated the CPython embedding API with Kotlin Multiplatform to run a native Python runtime on Android/iOS from a shared codebase.
Implemented a custom Jupyter kernel, embedding a Jupyter Notebook environment in the mobile app so code cells interact directly with live UI components.
Core developer of toolchain, a Python multiplatform build plugin for Kotlin Multiplatform Mobile workflows.
